primary.title: Supreme Petrochem Q2 results, dividend 2026: Check amount, record date, yield, history, stock returns
primary.summary: Supreme Petrochem declared a first interim dividend of ₹2.50 per share for FY27, with October 30 set as the record date. In Q2 FY27, revenue rose 77.8% year-on-year to ₹1,956.7 crore and profit after tax nearly doubled to ₹94.9 crore.
